description: This PHP source file serves as a launcher and controller for displaying test results and metrics within the TestLink open source test management tool. It initializes page settings, checks for linked test cases and builds, gathers report data, and renders the appropriate report view via Smarty templates.

methods.name: init_args
methods.description: Initializes and retrieves input parameters from request/session, setting defaults where necessary.

methods.name: initializeGui
methods.description: Sets up the GUI object with page-specific configurations, including test plan and project IDs, and access rights.

methods.name: checkRights
methods.description: Checks if the current user has the rights to view test plan metrics.
